item.title: Governor could replace local bar associations in selecting Marion County judges
item.description: A bill changing how Marion County Superior Court judges are selected is creating tension between Indianapolis lawmakers.

item.title: Residents urge Braun, lawmakers to regulate Indiana's growing data center industry
item.description: Indiana residents and environmental groups gathered at the State Library to urge lawmakers to regulate the state's rapidly expanding data center industry.

item.title: 5 takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address
item.description: President Trump hit familiar notes on immigration and culture in his speech Tuesday night, but he largely underplayed the economic problems that voters say they are most concerned about.

item.title: Rokita touts Indiana Medicaid provider fraud successes
item.description: The fraud is largely related to over-billing by providers and drug theft. He has no authority over recipient fraud.

item.title: Lawmakers eye road spending review as big southern Indiana plans face opposition
item.description: State highway agency hasn’t set new timeline for Mid-States Corridor project near Gov. Mike Braun’s home.

item.title: Mayor-appointed board to assume control of Indianapolis school facilities, finances under new legislation
item.description: The Indiana Senate passed legislation, creating a mayor-appointed board to oversee IPS finances and facilities. It now heads to the governor.

item.title: Report: ICE detention center planned for Indianapolis
item.description: A immigration detention facility that could hold up to 8,500 people may be headed to Indianapolis, according to internal federal documents obtained by The New York Times.

item.title: Why the Indiana Civil Rights Commission might lose its power to sue for you
item.description: A bill nearing final approval in the state legislature would limit the Indiana Civil Rights Commission’s power to represent Hoosiers who face illegal discrimination.

item.title: Indiana to investigate utilities after lawmakers raise concerns over residents' bills
item.description: The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission will hold a public hearing March 24 with five major utility companies.

item.title: Trump-aligned immigration bill heads to governor; mandates cities, schools cooperate with ICE
item.description: Indiana's Senate Bill 76, a sweeping measure to align local law enforcement and public institutions with federal immigration enforcement, remains poised for final approval despite a delay in the Senate on Thursday.
